headerDisplay:
Brings UniFi Protect cameras to Apple Home and HomeKit Secure Video, preferring direct stream passthrough over transcoding.

Use a **dedicated local Protect user** — not a Ubiquiti cloud account. The plugin never contacts Ubiquiti's cloud.
footerDisplay: See the [README](https://github.com/QandnotU/homebridge-unifi-protect-camera#readme) for setup, and ARCHITECTURE.md for design notes.

name.title: Name
name.description: Name shown in the Homebridge log.

name.title: Name
name.description: Optional label used in logs. Defaults to the host address.

host.title: Host
host.description: Hostname or IP address of the Protect controller on your local network.

username.title: Username
username.description: A dedicated local Protect user with camera access.

verifyTls.title: Verify TLS certificate
verifyTls.description: Leave off unless you have installed your own certificate. Protect controllers use a self-signed certificate by default.

maximumQuality.title: Maximum HomeKit Quality
maximumQuality.description: Always prefer the highest-quality compatible Protect stream and never step down to save bandwidth. Prioritises image quality over CPU and network cost.

verboseDiagnostics.title: Verbose streaming diagnostics
verboseDiagnostics.description: Log the full per-session record (negotiation, chosen source, delivery mode, timings) instead of a one-line summary.
